verdict.rationale: Resend documents a suppressions API endpoint for adding an email address to the suppression list, so suppressions can be managed programmatically. Webhooks for email events give a way to react to bounces and complaints. However, the evidence only shows the add operation, with nothing on listing or reading entries or on how bounce, complaint and unsubscribe types differ. Missing for 10: documented list/read/remove suppression endpoints, per-type (bounce/complaint/unsubscribe) suppression categories, evidence that hard bounces are suppressed automatically, independent corroboration.
